checks.concern: A login-node or local process could generate model scores.
checks.evidence: Only run_semantic_descriptor.sbatch invokes semantic_descriptor_runtime.py; submit and harvest scripts never invoke the model.

checks.concern: Registry LFS hashes could be treated as locally verified.
checks.evidence: The allocated stage job downloads the exact revision, locally recomputes all six sizes and SHA-256 values, and promotes atomically only on an exact match.

checks.concern: Descriptor inference could run before stage authority.
checks.evidence: The descriptor submitter requires a schema-valid HARVEST_MODEL_STAGE_PASS bound to the same exact checkout SHA; the compute-node runtime revalidates that harvest.

checks.concern: The shared Paper 2 runtime could be silently modified.
checks.evidence: Bytecode and user-site writes are disabled, caches target node-local temporary storage, and a content-tree digest must remain equal before and after inference.

checks.concern: Missing SentencePiece could trigger an unregistered substitution.
checks.evidence: The frozen local tokenizer.json must load as a fast tokenizer and pass a pair probe; otherwise the descriptor returns typed CANNOT_CHECK.

checks.concern: A descriptor could be confused with a structural-signal or efficiency result.
checks.evidence: Submission, execution, harvest and readiness receipts explicitly deny structural-signal, training, efficiency, break-even and review authority.
